This '''mission''' was undertaken by [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Prelude==
Onboard Republic flagship the [[Resolute/Legends|Resolute]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] received a distress signal from [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Determined to prove herself as [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], Ahsoka took a [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|Nu-class attack shuttle]] and departed to investigate.

==The mission==
Upon her arrival on Tatooine, Ahsoka's shuttle's signal was jammed by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]]. Near [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]], Ahsoka was attacked by [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. Meanwhile on the Resolute, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|clone trooper captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CC-7567]], nicknamed "Rex" lost shuttle's signal. They realized that the distress signal was fake and Ahsoka has fallen directly into a Separatist trap. Anakin and Obi-Wan took the [[Twilight/Legends|Twilight]], a [[G9 Rigger-class light freighter/Legends|G9 ''Rigger''-class light freighter]] and rushed to the rescue. When they reached [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]], Ahsoka managed to comm her master and explained the situation to him. The Twilight was attacked by a squadron of [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]] but won this dogfight and successfully landed on Tatooine. The Jedi destroyed all droids.

==Aftermath==
When the droids were defeated, Anakin told Ahsoka that it was [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] trap. Ahsoka apologized for her foolishness and promised not to go it alone again.

==Behind the scenes==
The mission's first and only appearance was in the children's 3D adventure book ''[[The Clone Wars: Journey Through Hyperspace]]'', based on the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series.
